hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on for io-shop at ~13:37 (partial rollout: 163 off / 37 on that minute, fully on from 13:38). Every error minute from then on is a ZeroDivisionError on the account page — a divide-by-zero in the monthly-spend code path the flag enables — replacing the pre-existing low-level UpstreamTimeout noise. Argus's 'off' at 13:43:30 did not help because the service kept evaluating the flag as on (logs show monthly-spend-feature=on through 13:49), i.e. the disable never propagated to the running instances.

supporting_evidence.claim: 2026-09-12T13:37:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
error_rate jumps from 0.01 at 13:36 to 0.06 at 13:37 and 0.31 at 13:38, staying ~0.3

All pre-onset errors are a different, low-rate failure: 'ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - UpstreamTimeout: payment authorization timed out' with 'monthly-spend-feature=off - 200 evaluations'
flag-toggle: feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on, actor admin
Logs still read 'monthly-spend-feature=on - 200 evaluations' at 13:44–13:49, i.e. during the interval the change log records the flag as switched off by Argus at 13:43:30
